title: Universal clock in/out works even for a user whose role has (almost) no permissions
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a custom role that has essentially no permissions.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Find the universal clock in/out control.
  3. Clock in.
  4. Clock out.
  5. As an admin, check the entries appear in the user's timesheet.
custom_expected:
Clock in and clock out both work.

Even a user with no permissions can track time — universal clock in is not gated by role.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live role editor / roles list)
